sources.officialProductEvidence: The official page confirms QST 100 Black, article reference L49189200+, sizes 148/156/164/172/180/188 cm, 100 mm waist, intermediate and advanced levels, Freeride Profile, Rocker-Camber-Rocker, 13.5 m displayed radius, 130-100-118 mm displayed sidecut, Full Poplar Woodcore, Ti Binding Reinforcement, Basalt Superlight Fibers, Fiberglass, Full Sandwich Sidewalls and Cork Damplifier.
sources.seasonEvidence: The official product listing marks QST 100 Black as New in the current lineup; the 2026/27 Salomon catalogue includes QST 100. The product detail page itself does not print a season label.

catalogueAndTestReport.evidence: The retailer's 2026/27 staff test report lists per-length sidecut, radius, and ski-only mass (1/2 pair) for 156/164/172/180/188 cm. It identifies the 172 cm ski as 1780 g. The official product page separately includes a 148 cm size, but the report does not publish that size's geometry or weight.

mappingNotes: The 13.5 m radius and 130-100-118 mm sidecut displayed by Salomon's official product page are not associated with a stated length, so they are not mapped to the 148 cm size. The retailer's report provides per-length values only for 156-188 cm; the 148 cm geometry and weight remain unknown.
imageRights: The official product image URL is a source reference only; no explicit reuse license verified.
